visual.title: A positive test does not replace the prior
visual.caption: The prior sets the first split. A positive test moves probability toward disease, but when the disease is rare the healthy-positive leaf can still be much larger, so the posterior stays small.

predict.question: With prior 1%, sensitivity 95% and specificity 90%, P(D | +) is about
predict.explain: The positive leaves are 0.0095 and 0.099. Dividing the disease leaf by their sum gives 0.0095 / 0.1085, about 0.0876, or 8.8%. The sensitivity alone is not the posterior.

label: The law of total probability
subgoals: Weight each likelihood by its prior
